notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Declare Aurelia and The Mighty Thor as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Mighty Thor trigger, blinking Aurelia and causing it to enter tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
